name: project-starter-pack
description: Designer-first AI project starter. Walks you through a Product, Design, and Technical brief, then synthesizes AGENTS.md and WRITING.md — read natively by Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity — plus the optional harness files you select (CLAUDE.md, Cursor scoped rules), so any AI coding agent designs and codes with the same rigor as a senior team.
